The experience

The bar is where the evening gathers

At any good party, people find their way to the bar. It is where old friends reconnect, where the toast gets raised, and where the night finds its rhythm. Stirring Up is built around that simple truth.

Every event starts with a custom consultation with the host. We talk through the whole evening together, moment by moment, so nothing is left to chance and every guest is looked after.

A bar that belongs in the room

Stirring Up brings a custom made portable bar that sets up at your venue and looks like it was always meant to be there. It arrives set, stocked, and ready before your first guest walks in.

The owner is your bartender

The bartender is the owner himself. The person who plans the evening with you is the person pouring at it, so what you talked through together is exactly what your guests get.

About us

A passion for moments that stay with you

Stirring Up was built on a simple idea. The best evenings are remembered not just for what was poured, but for how people felt while they were together.

There is a moment at every great gathering when the room settles in. Glasses are raised, conversations deepen, and nobody is thinking about the time. Creating that moment is what we love to do, and it is why hospitality sits at the center of everything at Stirring Up.

We plan each event around its moments, from the first welcome to the final toast, because those moments turn into memories that last a lifetime. You cannot put a price tag on an experience like that. It is priceless in the truest sense, and it deserves care long before the first guest arrives.

What makes an evening unforgettable is rarely one big gesture. It is attention to detail in a hundred small ones. The right drink at the right moment. A bar that feels calm and ready. A guest who does not drink alcohol being handed something just as thoughtful. That is the hospitality we bring to every wedding, celebration, and corporate gathering we pour for.

“You cannot put a price tag on an experience your guests will carry with them long after the night ends.”

Alejandro

The mixologist

Alejandro brings over five years of experience behind the bar in upscale dining, where the standard is high and every detail counts. That time taught him how to read a room, pace an evening well, and craft a drink that suits the person standing in front of him.

More than technique, it gave him a love for creating experiences worth repeating. Guests come back for a good cocktail. They remember, and return for, how they were made to feel.

The drinks

Planned with you, poured with care

The menu is part of the consultation. We build it around your guests, your food, and the moments of your evening, so every person at the bar finds something worth raising.

Signature cocktails

Created for your event and yours alone. A drink named for the couple, built around a favorite flavor, or matched to the colors and season of the evening. It becomes the one guests talk about on the way home.

Classics, done properly

The drinks people already love, made the right way. Balanced, cold, and consistent from the first pour to the last, with fresh garnish and good ice every time.

Beer and wine, chosen with you

We pick the beer and wine together in the consultation, matched to your menu, your guests, and your budget. Enough variety to please the room, without overbuying.

Mocktails and non alcoholic drinks

A full mocktail and non alcoholic program given the same care as everything else on the bar. Real recipes, real garnish, served in proper glassware, so guests who are not drinking never feel like an afterthought.

How it works

Three steps to a well poured evening

1

Say hello

Send an inquiry with the basics: your date, where the event will be, and about how many guests you expect. That is enough to start the conversation.

2

Talk details

This is the custom consultation, and it is the heart of Stirring Up. Using a consultation checklist, we give every moment of the event its drink:

  • The welcome as guests arrive
  • Cocktail hour
  • Dinner
  • The toast
  • Last call and the close of the night
3

Raise a glass

Once the details are set, your booking is confirmed and your date is reserved. On the day, the bar arrives ready and you get to be a guest at your own event.

Good to know

Questions, answered plainly

Where do you serve?

Stirring Up serves Dallas Fort Worth, including Dallas, Fort Worth, McKinney, Plano, Frisco, Allen, Anna, and the wider metroplex. If your venue sits a little further out, ask anyway. Travel can often be arranged.

What is included, and what does it cost?

Every booking includes the consultation, the custom made portable bar, setup at your venue, and the owner bartending your event, along with the tools and service plan you agree together. Pricing depends on your date, guest count, and the drinks you choose, so your consultation ends with a clear quote before anything is booked. There are no surprises added later.

Does an inquiry reserve my date?

No. An inquiry simply starts the conversation and costs nothing. Your date is reserved once your booking is confirmed after the consultation. Until then, the date stays open, which is why reaching out early is a good idea for popular weekends.

Do you sell alcohol?

No. Stirring Up is a mixologist service, not a bar. You, the host, choose the drinks. The alcohol for your event is purchased for your event, the receipts go to you, and any leftovers stay with you. Stirring Up provides the bartender, the bar, and the craft.

What about guests who do not drink?

They are fully part of the plan. Stirring Up builds a mocktail and non alcoholic program with the same care as the cocktail menu, with real recipes, fresh garnish, and proper glassware. Every guest gets something worth raising, whether or not it has alcohol in it.

What do you bring?

The custom made portable bar, professional bar tools, and the full setup for your drink plan, all confirmed with you during the consultation. You provide the venue and the drinks you chose, and Stirring Up handles the rest of the bar.
